The sphere in which I move is bounded by the limits of space, and the period of my sojourn is limited to the duration of time. I am born, I live, I die. I am the sea. In calm weather I am blue and green, and in stormy weather black. I wash down channels and carry them to the ocean. I bathe the coasts, and help them to bear flowers in spring, and fruits in summer. In harvest I give them to the reapers, and in winter to the millers. Through me, fish are able to swim, and men to sail. I am the great water highway. I wash out bad smells, and purify unwholesome airs. I bathe the sick, and I wash the dead. Through me, countries are united, and the world made one. I am the source of springs, and the sea is the source of rivers.
